# Patrol reconnaissance

Used in [Combat](/rules/60-combat).

## Table

| Die | Units revealed |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1: 0<br>2: 0<br>3: 1 |
| 2 | 1: 0<br>2: 1<br>3: 1 |
| 3 | 1: 1<br>2: 1<br>3: 2 |
| 4 | 1: 1<br>2: 2<br>3: 3 |
| 5 | 1: 2<br>2: 3<br>3: 4 |
| 6 | 1: 3<br>2: 4<br>3: all |

## Notes

- Rows are the die; columns are net patrol points (1-3); the cell is how many battalion-size-equivalent units in the target hex the patrolling player receives reconnaissance information about (SPI 16.5); 'all' = every unit
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 97) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p3): 0 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
